reportForm.title: Nenani Chochitika
reportForm.subtitle: Simuli nokha. Lembani fomu yachinsinsi iyi kuti tikuthandizeni kulumikizana ndi ntchito zothandizira zomwe mukufuna.
reportForm.currentlySafe: Kodi muli pamalo otetezeka pakali pano?
reportForm.perpetratorNearby: Kodi munthu amene akukuchitirani nkhanza ali pafupi?
reportForm.descriptionPlaceholder: Lembani zambiri zomwe muli omasuka kugawana...
reportForm.confidentialityText: Zambiri zanu zidzasungidwa mwachinsinsi ndipo zidzagawidwa kokha ndi othandizira ovomerezeka kuti akuthandizeni kupeza thandizo lomwe mukufuna.
reportForm.reportReceived: Lipoti lanu lidzalandiridwa, koma sitidzakulumikizani kuti tikufunseni zambiri pokhapokha mutasankha kuti tikulumikizeni.
reportForm.submitError: Papezeka vuto potumiza lipoti lanu. Chonde yesaninso.

validation.safeNow: Chonde sonyezani ngati muli pamalo otetezeka pano.
validation.danger: Chonde sonyezani ngati munthu amene akukuchitirani nkhanza ali pafupi.
validation.supportNeeded: Chonde sankhani mtundu wa thandizo limodzi.
validation.phoneRequired: Chonde lembani nambala yanu ya foni chifukwa mwasankha njira yolumikizirana.
validation.invalidPhone: Chonde lembani nambala ya foni yolondola.

healthPep.label: Zaumoyo ndi PEP
healthPep.description: Chithandizo chaumoyo, PEP mkati mwa maola 72

legalAid.label: Thandizo la Malamulo
legalAid.description: Dziwani za ufulu wanu, pezani thandizo

rightsSection.title: Dziwani za Ufulu Wanu
rightsSection.legalProtectionRights: Dziwani Ufulu Wanu wa Mwalamulo ndi Chitetezo

safety.title: Ufulu Wotetezeka ndi Chitetezo
safety.description: Muli ndi ufulu wofunafuna chitetezo ku nkhanza, ziwopsezo, kapena ngozi zina komanso kupeza chithandizo choyenera cha chitetezo.

dignity.title: Ufulu wa Ulemu ndi Kulemekezedwa
dignity.description: Muli ndi ufulu wochitiridwa ulemu, chifundo, ndi kulemekezedwa nthawi yonse yomwe mukulandira thandizo kapena kupereka lipoti.

confidentiality.title: Ufulu wa Chinsinsi
confidentiality.description: Zambiri zanu ndi zomwe mwanena ziyenera kusungidwa mwachinsinsi ndipo zigawidwe pokhapokha ngati pakufunika komanso moyenera.

choice.title: Ufulu Wopanga Zosankha Zanu
choice.description: Muli ndi ufulu wolandira zambiri zomveka zokhudza njira zomwe zilipo komanso kupanga zisankho zodziwa bwino zokhudza thandizo lomwe mukufuna, ngati kuli koyenera.

nonDiscrimination.title: Ufulu Wosasankhidwa
nonDiscrimination.description: Muli ndi ufulu wolandira thandizo popanda kusankhidwa chifukwa cha jenda, zaka, kulumala, mbiri yanu, kapena zinthu zina zokhudza inu.

medical.title: Ufulu wa Thandizo la Zaumoyo
medical.description: Muli ndi ufulu wofunafuna chithandizo choyenera cha kuchipatala pambuyo pa nkhanza, kuphatikizapo chithandizo cha thanzi la kugonana ndi kubereka ngati chikufunika.

psychosocial.title: Ufulu wa Thandizo la Maganizo
psychosocial.description: Muli ndi ufulu wofunafuna upangiri ndi thandizo lina la maganizo kuti likuthandizeni kuthana ndi zotsatira za nkhanza.

legal.title: Ufulu wa Thandizo la Malamulo
legal.description: Muli ndi ufulu wolandira zambiri zokhudza njira zamalamulo komanso kufunafuna thandizo loyenera la malamulo ndi chilungamo.

supportServices.title: Ufulu Wopeza Ntchito Zothandizira
supportServices.description: Mutha kufunafuna thandizo kuchokera ku ntchito za zaumoyo, zachitukuko, apolisi, zamalamulo, ndi chitetezo kutengera zosowa zanu.

partners.ministryGender: Unduna woona za kusiyana kwa amai ndi abambo

historyHelp.title: Momwe Mungachotsere Mbiri Yanu Yosakatula Mosamala
historyHelp.chromeInstructions: Tsegulani Menu (⋮) → History → Clear browsing data → sankhani "History" ndi "Cookies" → Clear data.
historyHelp.safariInstructions: Tsegulani pulogalamu ya Settings → Safari → Clear History and Website Data.
historyHelp.safetyNote: Izi zimachotsa mbiri yosakatula pa chipangizo chanu, koma sizichotsa zolemba zomwe zimasungidwa ndi kampani yanu ya foni kapena wopereka Wi-Fi. Ngati kuli kotetezeka, gwiritsani ntchito foni ya mnzanu kapena kompyuta ya laibulale ya anthu onse.
